description: This file defines API endpoints for analytics related to git events, including computation of analytics data, retrieval of commits, PRs, active contributors, recent activity, and dashboard metrics. It heavily interacts with database tables such as git_events, analytics_repo_daily, analytics_dev_daily, and repos, providing on-demand aggregation and dashboard data.

classes.name: AnalyticsComputeRequest
classes.description: Request model for computing analytics aggregates, specifying organization, optional repository, and date range.

classes.name: AnalyticsComputeResponse
classes.description: Response model containing details of the analytics computation, including upsert counts and timestamps.

classes.name: DayCountPoint
classes.description: Data point for daily counts (e.g., commits).

classes.name: PullRequestsDayPoint
classes.description: Data point for daily pull request opened and merged counts.

classes.name: DashboardMetricsResponse
classes.description: Aggregated data structure for dashboard metrics, including series of counts and recent activity.

classes.name: RepoCountPoint
classes.description: Repository-based count data used for top repositories metrics.

classes.name: RecentActivityItem
classes.description: Details of a recent git event for activity feeds.

classes.name: ActiveContributorsResponse
classes.description: Count of active contributors within a date range.

methods.name: None _validate_org_repo_scope(org_id: UUID, repo_id: Optional[UUID], db: Session)
methods.description: Validates that the given repo_id belongs to the specified organization.

methods.name: int _compute_repo_daily(db: Session, *, org_id: UUID, repo_id: Optional[UUID], start_ts: datetime, end_ts: datetime)
methods.description: Aggregates and upserts daily repository-related git metrics into analytics tables.

methods.name: int _compute_dev_daily(db: Session, *, org_id: UUID, repo_id: Optional[UUID], start_ts: datetime, end_ts: datetime)
methods.description: Aggregates and upserts daily developer-related git metrics into analytics tables.

methods.name: AnalyticsComputeResponse compute_analytics(req: AnalyticsComputeRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Endpoint to trigger on-demand computation of analytics aggregates.

methods.name: List[DayCountPoint] commits_per_day( org_id: UUID = Query(..., description="Organization UUID."), repo_id: Optional[UUID] = Query(default=None, description="Optional repo UUID."), start_date: Optional[date] = Query(default=None, description="Start date (inclusive, UTC)."), end_date: Optional[date] = Query(default=None, description="End date (exclusive, UTC)."), db: Session = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Fetches daily commit counts for an org/repo.

methods.description: Fetches daily PR opened/merged counts for an org/repo.

methods.name: DashboardMetricsResponse dashboard_metrics( org_id: UUID = Query(..., description="Organization UUID."), repo_id: Optional[UUID] = Query(default=None, description="Optional repo UUID."), start_date: Optional[date] = Query(default=None, description="Start date (inclusive, UTC)."), end_date: Optional[date] = Query(default=None, description="End date (exclusive, UTC)."), recent_limit: int = Query(default=50, ge=1, le=200, description="Max recent activity items."), top_repos_limit: int = Query(default=10, ge=1, le=200, description="Max repos in merged-PR ranking."), db: Session = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Fetches consolidated dashboard metrics, including commits, PRs, active contributors, and recent activity.

methods.name: List[RepoCountPoint] prs_merged_per_repo( org_id: UUID = Query(..., description="Organization UUID."), start_date: Optional[date] = Query(default=None, description="Start date (inclusive, UTC)."), end_date: Optional[date] = Query(default=None, description="End date (exclusive, UTC)."), limit: int = Query(default=50, ge=1, le=200, description="Max repos returned (sorted by merged count desc)."), db: Session = Depends(get_db_session), )
